body:
Thanks @Morhaus for clarification.

I think I will go with something that will not just provide a way to create a key but also contextualize the data. So that you can know what type of filter this is (faceting, searchParameter..):

``` js
{
  type: 'facet',
  attributeName: '..',
  value: '..', // refinementValue
  label: '..'
}
```

So that connected Component will have more power to decide how to show them. Otherwise for query for instance you had no way to know what the query was.

> I added a filter to search so that the ClearAll component could also clear the search

Not sure I got this right, there's no ClearAll component right now.

Here's my plan:
- remove clear button from currentFilters
- create a ClearAll component and connector
- default ClearAll component will display filters the right way (no query clear)
- connected ClearAll will be able to clear only some filters
- connected CurrentFilters will be able to clear only some filters

> I believe this behavior is consistent with instantsearch v1?

I #failed on this one while you were here, because the goal of react-instantsearch was to get feedback on ISV1 then make it so that the API is better, even if it means not being consistent with ISV1. There's no need to be 100% consistent with ISV1, we just need to be better and keep the overall experience.
